messages:
Priya: Quick flag 12 candidates lost their interviewer assignment after I ran a tag migration for 'region:EMEA' -> 'region:EMEA-v2' around 2024-12-05 14:05 UTC. Noticed when prepping interviewer roster.
Omar: How did you run the migration? UI bulk-edit or the backfill script?
Priya: UI > Candidates > Bulk actions > Replace tags. I replaced region tags and also toggled the 'normalize_tags' checkbox. It seemed fast but now many candidate profiles show assignee: null.
Jules: Can you paste a sample candidate id? I want to check audit_events and scheduled_interviews tables.
Priya: Sent list of 212 candidate IDs to the thread (CSV).
Omar: Looking at DB audit, I see clustered updates where candidate.tags changed and a concurrent nullable update on candidate.assignee happened: ```UPDATE candidates SET tags = $1 WHERE id = $2; -- followed by UPDATE candidates SET assignee_id = NULL WHERE id = $2;``` Not expected.
Tanya: That's worrying. Interviewers are already invited for tomorrow. If assignee cleared, calendar invites might still have the old attendees, but prep packets in our docstore are keyed off assignee+template.
ATSBot: Alert: bulk-tag-normalize job completed (2024-12-05T14:05:23Z) - replaced 9,840 tags.
Jules: Hypothesis: the UI flow triggers a downstream normalizer job that writes normalized_tag_set and then a cleanup function resets stale assignees when tag normalization fails validation. Maybe our validation flagged some legacy tag formats and the cleanup zeroed assignees.
Omar: Can we trace which service issued the assignee nullification? Check deploy logs for candidate-service and tag-normalizer between 14:04-14:07 UTC.
Priya: I pulled the candidate-service logs: ```INFO candidate.update id=abc123 changes={'tags': ['region:EMEA-v2']} WARN candidate.assignee_cleared reason='tag-sanity-fix' trace=trace-99```
Tanya: Whoops. That 'tag-sanity-fix' path shouldn't touch assignees. That sounds like a bug from the last deploy. Which release included tag-sanity-fix?
Jules: Tag-normalizer v2.3.1 rolled out yesterday and has a new cleanup handler to remove inconsistent assignees for tags that don't map to any hiring pool. The mapping table had an empty row for 'region:EMEA-v2' so it treated those candidates as unmapped and cleared assignees.
Omar: Plan: 1) Stop the normalizer job (paused), 2) Rebuild assignees from audit trail (we have prior assignee values in audit_events), 3) Re-attach scorecard templates and training links, 4) Postmortem + hotfix to avoid assignee clearance path for UI bulk edits.
Priya: I'll pause the job now.
ATSBot: Action taken: tag-normalizer job paused by Priya at 2024-12-05T14:18:02Z.
Jules: Rebuilding assignees via audit replay. Query I used: ```WITH last_assignee AS ( SELECT candidate_id, (jsonb_path_query_first(changed_fields, '$.assignee_id') ->> 'old')::int as old_assignee FROM audit_events WHERE event_type='candidate.update' AND created_at < '2024-12-05 14:05:00' ) INSERT INTO candidate_assignees(candidate_id, assignee_id) SELECT candidate_id, old_assignee FROM last_assignee WHERE old_assignee IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;```
Omar: Nice. Run a dry-run first and output count. We should only restore candidates in the CSV.
Jules: Dry-run shows 210 restorations, 2 candidates had no previous assignee.
Tanya: For those 2, we need to triage manually and assign interviewers. Also, prep packets: generator filters templates by candidate.tags and assignee.role. Because tags were rewritten, some templates didn't match. Sam (ops) will need to re-run prep-gen for restored IDs.
Priya: I'll message interviewers for tomorrow and ask them to hold until I confirm assignments.
Omar: Also add a guard in the UI: when doing 'Replace tags' we should warn if any of the affected candidate rows have non-null assignees and require a confirmation checkbox.
Jules: Agreed. And the normalizer should never clear assignees in a UI-initiated bulk edit context. We'll add an allowlist and a safety flag.
ATSBot: Incident INC-2024-411 created and assigned to @Jules.
Priya: Real replay executed at 2024-12-05T14:34:10Z - restored 210 assignees. Migration tag: candidate-assignee-restore-20241205.
Tanya: Prep generator re-run queued. ETA 12 minutes due to rate limits.
Omar: I'll open a release-blocking PR for tag-normalizer to revert the cleanup and add tests for mapping table empties.
Priya: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short retro in #people-ops and add two immediate actions: manual checks for bulk edits + UI confirmation modal. Marking this thread for follow-ups only. :white_check_mark:
